messages:
Asha: Quick presales ask from WaveMart — want websocket SDK streaming + server-side function callbacks to post order JSON. Need: auth pattern, idempotency, retry behavior, and a 2-week cost ballpark at ~400 rps. @tom @ravi
Tom: Recommend WS + HMAC-signed webhook (X-RW-Signature). Webhook should ack 200 immediately. Use call_id + order_id for idempotency.
Ravi: For 400 rps steady (peaks ~800) enable client batching (batch_size=6) and server TTL=30ms. Retry policy: 5 attempts expo backoff with jitter; honor Retry-After for 429.
Asha: Can we share a tiny example and a short checklist to send to their devs?
Tom: Small checklist: 1) Verify HMAC header, 2) Persist order_id+call_id, 3) Return 200 fast, 4) Support idempotency window >=24h, 5) Watch Retry-After on 429.
Ravi: Dev snippet (pseudo): ws.on('func_call', m => { ws.ack(m.id); fetch(WEBHOOK, {method:'POST', body:JSON.stringify(m.payload)}); });
LegalBot: If webhook payload contains PII, legal needs the security questionnaire + SOC2 confirmation. Otherwise can proceed with anonymized demo data.
InfraBot: Presales cluster provisioned: presales-wave (6xA10G). Ingress cap 1400 qps. Console: https://console.redwood/presales-wave
Asha: Perfect — I'll send checklist + snippet and ask finance for the ballpark. Kickoff Thurs 9am PT. Any blockers?
